If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14268989/assets/bdbe38e4c652e888c4eea890738bccb4d70804cd2b7c23058f72dd2c8996d717.svg)

Here, we have $X \sim U \left\lbrace 7, 8, 9, \ldots, 21 \right\rbrace,$ and the set $S = \left\lbrace 7, 8, 9, \ldots, 21 \right\rbrace$ has $|S|=21 - 7 + 1 = 15$ items. So, we have

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14268989/assets/4757730008d9d00bdd406065d1aaad881d6b2a95bb65dc9a021982b00cbd9059.svg)

Therefore,

$$
P(X = 18) = f(18) = \dfrac{1}{15}.
$$
